command:
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import json,os,socket,sqlite3,subprocess,sys,threading,traceback
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(strict=True)
temporary=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(strict=True)
expected=sys.argv[3]
assert Path(sys.executable).resolve()==root/'runtime/python/python.exe'
assert sys.flags.isolated and sys.flags.no_site and sys.flags.ignore_environment and sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode
assert sys.dont_write_bytecode and not temporary.is_relative_to(root)
attempts={name:0 for name in ('socket','database','subprocess','thread','futu_import','server_import')}
def denied(kind):
    def stop(*args,**kwargs):
        attempts[kind]+=1
        raise RuntimeError('installed_protobuf_forbidden:'+kind)
    return stop
socket.socket.connect=denied('socket');socket.socket.connect_ex=denied('socket')
socket.create_connection=denied('socket');socket.getaddrinfo=denied('socket')
sqlite3.connect=denied('database');subprocess.Popen.__init__=denied('subprocess');threading.Thread.start=denied('thread')
def audit(event,args):
    if event.startswith('socket.'):denied('socket')()
    if event.startswith('sqlite3.connect'):denied('database')()
    if event in {'subprocess.Popen','os.system'} or event.startswith('os.spawn'):denied('subprocess')()
    if event=='import' and args:
        if args[0]=='futu' or args[0].startswith('futu.'):denied('futu_import')()
        if args[0]=='exchange_terminal.server':denied('server_import')()
sys.addaudithook(audit)
try:
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('terminal_bootstrap',root/'resources/app/terminal-bootstrap.py')
    bootstrap=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(bootstrap)
    manifest=bootstrap.verify(root);bootstrap.initialize(root,manifest)
    assert manifest['source_provenance']['git']=={'commit':expected,'status':'CLEAN'}
    manifest_sha=sha256((root/'terminal-manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    from exchange_terminal.services.terminal_broker_package_loader import load_broker_runtime_identity
    from exchange_terminal.adapters import futu_verified_protobuf_loader as loader
    imported=Path(loader.__file__).resolve()
    assert imported==root/'components/terminal/exchange_terminal/adapters/futu_verified_protobuf_loader.py'
    assert sha256(imported.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==manifest['files'][imported.relative_to(root).as_posix()]
    assert not any(name=='futu' or name.startswith('futu.') or name=='google' or name.startswith('google.') or name.endswith('_pb2') for name in sys.modules)
    loaded_runtime=load_broker_runtime_identity('OFFICIAL_SIMULATION')
    runtime=loaded_runtime.runtime_identity
    assert runtime is not None and runtime.as_dict()['adapter'] is None
    bindings=loader.load_verified_protobuf(package_root=root,expected_manifest_sha256=manifest_sha,runtime_identity=runtime)
    metadata=bindings.as_dict()
    checks=[]
    for protocol,name in loader.PROTO_NAMES.items():
        request=bindings.request_classes[protocol]()
        assert request.DESCRIPTOR.full_name==name+'.Request'
        response=bindings.response_classes[protocol]();response.retType=0
        raw=response.SerializeToString()
        decoded=bindings.response_classes[protocol]();decoded.ParseFromString(raw)
        assert decoded.HasField('retType') and decoded.retType==0
        assert decoded.DESCRIPTOR.full_name==name+'.Response'
        checks.append(dict(protocol=protocol,request=request.DESCRIPTOR.full_name,response=decoded.DESCRIPTOR.full_name,
            synthetic_response_bytes=len(raw),synthetic_response_sha256=sha256(raw).hexdigest()))
    assert len(checks)==11 and bindings.verify_current()==metadata
    try:loader.load_verified_protobuf(package_root=root,expected_manifest_sha256=manifest_sha,runtime_identity=runtime)
    except loader.ProtobufLoaderError as error:assert error.code=='NEW_PRIVATE_WORKER_REQUIRED'
    else:raise AssertionError('second loader call accepted')
    assert metadata['source_identity_only'] is True and metadata['runtime_compatibility']=='NOT_VERIFIED'
    assert metadata['production_transport_available'] is False and len(metadata['permissions'])==9 and not any(metadata['permissions'].values())
    for name,value in metadata['loaded_files'].items():
        assert value['sha256']==manifest['files'].get(name,manifest_sha if name=='terminal-manifest.json' else None)
    foreign={name:str(module.__file__) for name,module in tuple(sys.modules.items()) if getattr(module,'__file__',None)
        and not str(module.__file__).startswith('<') and not Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root)}
    assert not foreign and all(value and Path(value).resolve().is_relative_to(root) for value in sys.path)
    assert not any(attempts.values())
    bootstrap.verify(root)
    proof=dict(status='PASS_INSTALLED_PRIVATE_PROTOBUF_SOURCE_IDENTITY',source_commit=expected,bundle_id=manifest['bundle_id'],
        manifest_sha256=manifest_sha,private_python=str(Path(sys.executable).resolve()),loader_module=str(imported),
        loader_module_sha256=sha256(imported.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),runtime_identity=runtime.as_dict(),
        loader_identity=metadata,protocol_roundtrips=checks,attempts=dict(attempts),second_load='NEW_PRIVATE_WORKER_REQUIRED',
        external_modules=0,economic_runs=0,account_facts_created=0,worker_dispatches=0,server_or_gui_started=False,
        current_source_injection=False,private_flags_mocked=False,source_repository_inaccessible_guest_test=False,
        scope='ACTUAL_INSTALLED_PINNED_PROTOBUF_CLASSES_WITH_MINIMAL_SYNTHETIC_RET_TYPE_BYTES_ONLY')
    with (temporary/'result.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stream:json.dump(proof,stream,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    print(json.dumps({key:proof[key] for key in ('status','bundle_id','attempts','economic_runs')},ensure_ascii=False))
finally:
    with (temporary/'guard-final.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        json.dump(dict(attempts=attempts,private_flags=dict(isolated=sys.flags.isolated,no_site=sys.flags.no_site,
            ignore_environment=sys.flags.ignore_environment,dont_write_bytecode=sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode)),stream,indent=2)
